question: When is the Indian Armed Forces Veterans Day observed annually ?
solution:
The correct answer is** __14 January__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Armed forces Veterans day is observed each year on January** 14 since 2017.**
 
• The Armed forces veterans day recognizes the service rendered by field **Marshal KM Cariappa,**
 
• The Marshal KM Cariappa of the** first Indian commander-in-chief** of the Indian Armed forces​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian armed forces**

 
 
• The Indian Armed Forces are the military forces of the Republic of India.
 
• It consists of three professional uniformed services: the Indian **Army, Indian Navy, and Indian Air Force**
 
• The Indian Armed forces** Headquarters in New Delhi.**
